mapper.select: SELECT A.BROD_TIME AS brodTime, C.STRE_FILE_NM AS streFileNm, A.BROD_SEQ AS brodSeq, A.BROD_ANNSEQ AS brodAnnSeq, A.BROD_GUBUN AS brodGubun FROM TB_BRODORGANIZATION A JOIN TB_BRODSCHEDULE B ON A.BROD_CODE = B.BROD_CODE JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL C ON A.ATCH_FILE_ID = C.ATCH_FILE_ID JOIN TB_CENTERINFO D ON B.CENTER_ID = D.CENTER_ID JOIN TB_DIDINFO E ON D.CENTER_ID = E.CENTER_ID WHERE A.BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} AND TRIM(E.DID_ID) = #{didId} AND TRIM(E.DID_MAC) = #{didMac} ORDER BY BROD_TIME ASC

SELECT A.ORG_SEQ AS orgSeq, D.BROD_NAME AS brodName, A.BROD_TIME AS brodTime, A.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId, B.CODE_NM AS codeNm, B.CODE_DC AS codeDc, D.BASIC_FILE_ID AS basicFileId, C.ORIGNL_FILE_NM AS orignlFileNm, A.BROD_GUBUN AS secGubun FROM TB_BRODORGANIZATION A JOIN LETTCCMMNDETAILCODE B ON A.BROD_GUBUN = B.CODE JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL C ON A.BASIC_FILE_ID = C.ATCH_FILE_ID JOIN TB_BRODSCHEDULE D ON D.BROD_CODE = A.BROD_CODE WHERE A.BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BRODORGANIZATION SET BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}, REG_DATE = NOW(), ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId}, BROD_TIME = #{brodTime}, BROD_GUBUN = #{brodGubun}, CONTENT_PLAYDAY = #{contentPlayDay}, BROD_SEQ = #{brodSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BROD_ANNSEQ = #{brodAnnSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CENTER_ID = #{centerId} WHERE ORG_SEQ = #{orgSeq}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_BRODORGANIZATION WHERE BROD_CODE IN ( SELECT BROD_CODE FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE WHERE BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} OR BASIC_BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} )
